issues.where: hero plant, f1199 to f1200 at the 40.00 s cut
issues.what: The plant does not carry across the cut. In frost the head is an open, cup-shaped bud with a ring of spiky bracts on a short collar, there is one drooping leaf at mid-stem on the left and a large broad leaf on the right. In bloom the head is a closed, rounded bud and the leaves are a different set: a small curled leaf high on the left, a long curled leaf lower down, and no large right leaf. At normal speed the subject visibly swaps shape in one frame.
issues.fix: Render both worlds from the same plant rig and pose at the cut frame (same bud stage, same leaf count, positions and curl). Change only the materials, lighting and environment.

issues.where: horizon and ground line across the cut, f1199 to f1200
issues.what: The horizon does not line up. The frost field edge sits about 10 px lower on the sheet (roughly 40 px at native size) than the bloom field and hill line, so the ground plane jumps at the cut.
issues.fix: Lock the camera and the horizon or ground plane height between the two environments at the cut frame, then match the far field edge to the same scanline.

issues.where: whole frame, camera motion across the cut
issues.what: The camera's speed changes at the cut. Frame-to-frame registration shows no vertical drift through the frost frames f1194 to f1199, then a steady upward or tilting drift of about 1 sheet px per frame from f1200 on. The move starts or changes direction exactly at the cut, so it is not one continuous move.
issues.fix: Drive both segments from one continuous camera curve so position and velocity match through 40.00 s.

issues.where: ray petals lying across the face of the seed disc, f1280 to f1291
issues.what: The petals do not unfold from the rim along their own paths. They appear as flat strands lying over the disc face, and their arrangement redraws between consecutive frames. f1280 to f1281 jumps from a sparse lower-left cluster to a dense fan, and the strand layout keeps shifting frame to frame. It reads as texture boiling or morphing, and the petals sit on and through the disc instead of behind and around it.
issues.fix: Grow the ray florets from the edge of the head behind the bracts, each petal on its own continuous hinge and curl. Keep the geometry consistent from frame to frame so there is no per-frame regeneration.

issues.where: background field heads, f1265 to f1494
issues.what: Every background sunflower goes from bud to bloom at once, in step with the hero, and the small yellow heads seem to brighten in place more than open. At sheet size it is hard to tell whether they fade in or unfold.
issues.fix: Stagger the background bloom timing and drive it with geometry (petals opening), not opacity or emission ramps.

issues.where: bract spikes and petal highlights at the head's left edge
issues.what: The thin bright bract tips and the specular glints on the petal strands change slightly in brightness and shape from frame to frame beyond what the camera drift explains. This is a mild shimmer in fine detail.
issues.fix: Raise the sample count or temporal antialiasing on thin geometry and specular highlights, and stabilise the glint shading.
